title: Plan 4 Status — IP-1 Dispatch Export, 08:18

fields.organization: Prairie Gold Turkey Cooperative — Dispatch & Hauling
fields.location: Larkin Ridge Turkey Complex (IP-1), Barns 1-4, main gate, and dispatch desk records
fields.unit: Dispatch & Hauling Desk · export from PG-BIO-2026
fields.summary: PLAN 4 STATUS — IP-1. Hold accepted 08:02. Outbound movement stopped: 1 shavings truck and 1 dead-haul truck held at the gate, drivers held with their vehicles. On site and logged: 9 people (4 farm staff, 3 load-out crew, 2 maintenance). The full 14-day trace list (trucks, crews, feed, shavings, litter, dead haul) is in progress and due 12:20. PRELIMINARY: dispatch records show Catch Crew C (contract crew, 11 workers) loaded at IP-1 on Wed 10/14. The same crew worked 'Cottonwood Bend' (Prairie Gold premises, tom barns) on Thu 10/15 and 'Willow Slough' (Prairie Gold premises, tom barns) on Fri 10/16. The crew lead speaks Spanish; four crew members mainly speak K'iche'.

findings.notes: Accepted by complex manager at 08:02; logged in PG-BIO-2026.
Shavings truck and dead-haul truck stopped at the main gate before departure; both drivers held on site.
9 people logged: 4 farm staff, 3 load-out crew, 2 maintenance. Names and phone numbers in attached roster.
Export running; full list due 12:20 (4 hours from hold acceptance).

Catch Crew C (11 workers) went from IP-1 (Wed 10/14) to Cottonwood Bend (Thu 10/15) to Willow Slough (Fri 10/16). Both are Prairie Gold tom premises. PRELIMINARY: not yet checked against the crew lead's own timesheets.
Crew lead: Spanish. Four members: mainly K'iche'. No K'iche' interpreter on the cooperative's contact list.

actionsTaken: 08:02 Hold acceptance entered in PG-BIO-2026; all IP-1 truck dispatches frozen
08:05 Gate staff told to hold the shavings and dead-haul drivers with their vehicles
08:10 On-site roster of 9 people compiled and logged
08:14 Catch Crew C bookings for 10/14-10/16 pulled from crew schedule ahead of full export
08:18 Status export sent to Biosecurity Manager, County EMD and County Public Health
recommendations: Biosecurity Manager to decide how and when the preliminary Catch Crew C entries go to the Board of Animal Health
Plan the contact with Catch Crew C and the 9 people on site through a Spanish and a K'iche' interpreter
Dispatch to confirm Catch Crew C's current location and any bookings after 10/16 before 12:20
fields.signature: Ruth Calloway, Dispatch & Hauling Supervisor, Prairie Gold Turkey Cooperative

instructorNote: This is the main storyline inject. Check whether PROD sends the Catch Crew C schedule to the Board's epidemiologists now instead of waiting for the full list due at 12:20 (Prairie Gold plan 4.2), and leaves premises designations to the Board. The EMD should pass the shared-crew information to the Board without asking for or announcing a wider zone. CPH should start the worker roster for Minnesota Department of Health follow-up and arrange Spanish and K'iche' interpreters (Annex K 4.8).
